lines.say: Tier F, doing nothing. Clients quietly drift away, and you never find out.
Tier C, asking at the chair. It only reaches whoever is sitting in front of you.
Tier B, texting them yourself. It works, but with hundreds of clients, someone slips through.
Also tier B, Vah-rah-go. Booking comes first, and text marketing costs extra.
Tier A, Book-see. It texts lapsed clients for you, with two thousand marketing texts included.
Gloss Genius. Automatic rebooking texts, but only on the Gold plan.
Squire. Smart Rebooking learns client habits, and it runs win-back campaigns.
Tier S, Message Health. It scores every client against their own rhythm, and shows why they're at risk.
Then it texts the quiet ones back. Tie it into your favorite tool with your API keys.
Plans start at fifty dollars, and your first month is half off.
Comment RETAIN, and I will DM you personally. Not those automated bullshit ones.
